metadata.name: Geochemical Analysis of Sediment Core SO268_074MUC from Belgian Collector Trial Pre-Impact
metadata.description: This dataset contains high-resolution geochemical measurements from 9 sediment depth intervals (0.0625–0.225 m) within a single core (Core 18) collected at station SO268_074MUC. The data includes concentrations of 16 elements (Al, Ba, Ca2+, Cr, Cu, Fe, K+, La, Li, Mg2+, Mn, Na+, Ni, P, Sr, Ti), their relative and absolute error metrics, and various transformed values. All samples were collected at a single deep-sea location in the Pacific Ocean on March 20, 2019, as part of a pre-impact assessment for a Belgian collector trial.
metadata.spatial: Point location (single core at 14.13508333°N, 125.86365°W, depth intervals 0.0625–0.225 m)
